SELECT
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN er.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1) AS value
FROM (SELECT * FROM execution_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = execution_results.host_name AND df.device_name = execution_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE er.execution_type = 'verification'
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(ui.name, 'Unknown Interface') IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(er.executed_at, '1h') AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "Verifications"
FROM (SELECT * FROM execution_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = execution_results.host_name AND df.device_name = execution_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE er.execution_type = 'verification'
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(ui.name, 'Unknown Interface') IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  COALESCE(ui.name, 'Unknown Interface') || ' - ' || COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') AS "Variant",
  ROUND(AVG(er.execution_time_ms))::int AS "Avg Time",
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN er.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1) AS "Success",
  COUNT(*) AS "Volume"
FROM (SELECT * FROM execution_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = execution_results.host_name AND df.device_name = execution_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE er.execution_type = 'verification'
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(ui.name, 'Unknown Interface') IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY ui.name, er.variant
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY "Variant" ASC

WITH latest_executions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (
    CASE WHEN er.execution_type = 'action'
         THEN er.edge_id || '#' || er.action_set_id
         ELSE er.node_id
    END
  )
    CASE WHEN er.execution_type = 'action'
         THEN er.edge_id || '#' || er.action_set_id
         ELSE er.node_id
    END AS element_key,
    er.execution_type,
    er.tree_id,
    er.node_id,
    er.edge_id,
    er.action_set_id,
    er.variant,
    er.is_test,
    er.executed_at,
    er.kpi_report_url,
    sr.html_report_r2_url
  FROM (SELECT * FROM execution_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = execution_results.host_name AND df.device_name = execution_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) er
  LEFT JOIN script_results sr ON er.script_result_id = sr.id
  LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
  LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
    AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
    AND (COALESCE(ui.name, 'Unknown Interface') IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN er.execution_type = 'action'
         THEN er.edge_id || '#' || er.action_set_id
         ELSE er.node_id
    END,
    er.executed_at DESC
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN le.execution_type = 'action' THEN 'Edge' ELSE 'Node' END AS "Type",
  COALESCE(ui.name, 'Unknown') AS "Interface",
  COALESCE(le.variant, 'Base') AS "Variant",
  le.is_test AS "Is Test",
  CASE
    WHEN le.execution_type = 'action' AND le.action_set_id LIKE '%_to_%' THEN
      REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(le.action_set_id, '_to_', 1), '_', ' ') || ' → ' ||
      REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(le.action_set_id, '_to_', 2), '_', ' ')
    WHEN le.execution_type = 'action' THEN
      REPLACE(le.action_set_id, '_', ' ')
    ELSE
      COALESCE(nn.label, 'Node ' || SUBSTRING(le.node_id, 1, 8))
  END AS "Name",
  CASE
    WHEN le.execution_type = 'action' THEN
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(em.total_executions, 0) = 0 THEN 'N/A'
           ELSE ROUND(em.success_rate * 100) || '%' END
    ELSE
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(nm.total_executions, 0) = 0 THEN 'N/A'
           ELSE ROUND(nm.success_rate * 100) || '%' END
  END AS "Success",
  CASE
    WHEN le.execution_type = 'action' THEN COALESCE(em.total_executions, 0)
    ELSE COALESCE(nm.total_executions, 0)
  END AS "Volume",
  CASE
    WHEN le.execution_type = 'action' THEN
      CASE WHEN em.avg_action_time_ms IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
           WHEN em.avg_action_time_ms < 1000 THEN ROUND(em.avg_action_time_ms) || 'ms'
           WHEN em.avg_action_time_ms < 60000 THEN ROUND(em.avg_action_time_ms/1000, 1) || 's'
           ELSE FLOOR(em.avg_action_time_ms/60000) || 'm ' || ROUND((em.avg_action_time_ms % 60000)/1000, 1) || 's'
      END
    ELSE
      CASE WHEN nm.avg_verification_time_ms IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
           WHEN nm.avg_verification_time_ms < 1000 THEN ROUND(nm.avg_verification_time_ms) || 'ms'
           WHEN nm.avg_verification_time_ms < 60000 THEN ROUND(nm.avg_verification_time_ms/1000, 1) || 's'
           ELSE FLOOR(nm.avg_verification_time_ms/60000) || 'm ' || ROUND((nm.avg_verification_time_ms % 60000)/1000, 1) || 's'
      END
  END AS "Duration",
  CASE
    WHEN le.execution_type = 'action' THEN
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(em.total_executions, 0) = 0 THEN 'N/A'
           ELSE ROUND(em.success_rate * 10) || '/10' END
    ELSE
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(nm.total_executions, 0) = 0 THEN 'N/A'
           ELSE ROUND(nm.success_rate * 10) || '/10' END
  END AS "Confidence",
  TO_CHAR(le.executed_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY, HH24:MI:SS') AS "Executed",
  COALESCE(le.kpi_report_url, le.html_report_r2_url) AS "Report URL"
FROM latest_executions le
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON le.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
LEFT JOIN navigation_nodes nn ON (le.node_id = nn.node_id AND le.tree_id = nn.tree_id)
LEFT JOIN edge_metrics em ON (
  le.execution_type = 'action'
  AND em.edge_id = le.edge_id
  AND em.action_set_id = le.action_set_id
)
LEFT JOIN node_metrics nm ON (
  le.execution_type = 'verification'
  AND nm.node_id = le.node_id
)
ORDER BY le.executed_at DESC
LIMIT 500

list.label: User Interface
list.name: user_interface
list.query: SELECT name FROM userinterfaces ORDER BY name

list.label: Variant
list.description: Run scope. Base = no --variant set. Each variant aggregates separately on edge_metrics.
list.name: variant
list.query: SELECT 'Base' AS variant UNION SELECT name FROM userinterface_variants UNION SELECT DISTINCT variant FROM execution_results WHERE variant IS NOT NULL ORDER BY variant

list.description: Filter by device tags set on the Device page
list.label: Tag
list.name: flag
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT f AS flag FROM device_flags, unnest(flags) f ORDER BY 1
